an5.264:1.1: “Without abandoning these five qualities, one is incapable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.
an5.264:1.3: Stinginess as to one’s monastery (lodgings), stinginess as to one’s family (of supporters), stinginess as to one’s gains, stinginess as to one’s status, and ingratitude.
an5.264:1.4: Without abandoning these five qualities, one is incapable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.
an5.264:2.1: “With the abandoning of these five qualities, one is capable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.…”
